title: EmojiDrop
summary: An emoji-only arcade shooter, two players side by side over WebRTC with shared lives and a tether between their ships — no Snap Pair here, and no server in the game loop.

mine: Designed an emoji-only two-player arcade shooter
Built peer-to-peer WebRTC play with shared lives and a tether between ships, with no server in the game loop
Built it as a single-file HTML5 Canvas game
